basic_profile.bio: A passionate Pokémon Go trainer hailing from Manchester, UK. I spend my evenings and weekends hunting for rare Pokémon and participating in raids. Outside of gaming, I have a keen interest in collecting budget-friendly knives and am always on the lookout for a great deal on a new blade. Working as a graphic designer allows me the flexibility to pursue my hobbies extensively. I'm currently single and enjoy connecting with fellow fans and trainers online. My typical online hours are late afternoons and evenings, often coordinating with friends across different time zones.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: With a background in graphic design, I have honed my skills through both formal education and self-guided exploration. My interest in Pokémon Go has been a continuous journey since the game's release, leading to an in-depth understanding of game mechanics and community dynamics. My expertise in budget blades comes from years of collecting and engaging with other enthusiasts online.
